proposals.evidence: The first kālya branch explicitly gives Western Pahari Bhadrawahi/Bhalesi kāla tomorrow, with Kotgarhi kallε and Kotkhai kala in the addenda. The Kullui kal response is placed with this directly documented neighbouring Western Pahari series; the modern reduced vowel does not by itself distinguish the prehistoric long/short alternatives.
